title: table
description: A table, for rows compared both along and across, each cell short; for a name and its longer text write entries, and for a line each a Markdown list. Each cell is a line of Markdown (code, bold, links), a number in quotes as it is drawn, a word of its column's pills, drawn as that pill, or a pill

items.description: Its title, a line of Markdown; or { id, title, num, pills } for a column holding more than its title

id.description: The key that names this column in a row written by keys

num.description: Numbers: aligned right, in a fixed-width font

pills.description: Words drawn as pills in this column, each with its tone: a cell that is one of them, whole, as { 'Done': good }

rows.description: Rows, each its cells in the order of the columns, as many as the columns, or its cells by the ids of the columns ({ id: cell }), a column left out drawn empty; a table may hold both
